page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a 3780 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present on this virtual machine.

Benchmark results place the D64ads_v6 in the top 25% for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng. In Geekbench testing, the multi-core score reaches the top 10% tier, while single-core execution remains in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance for small-block cached reads and large-block writes, though large-block uncached reads fall into the average category. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression. For machine learning workloads, LLM inference prompt processing with a small 135M model achieves top-tier performance, but throughput drops to average levels when scaling to larger 7B and 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D64ads_v6 offers high resource density by combining a high-core-count AMD EPYC processor with a substantial 3780 GB local storage allocation, eliminating the need for separate basic storage attachments for local scratch space. This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database hosting, static web serving, and moderate-scale language model inference.
